method: One browser/page at a time; generic 100/250-topic courses at 1440×1000. Expand and settle the graph, then first-open, close and reopen the sidebar list, observing each action for 600 ms. Four repetitions per browser/source/count; retain the first as warmup but exclude it from groups. Click timing includes the synchronous disclosure handler, firstFrame records wall time to the first rAF callback, and intervals use consecutive rAF timestamps. No physical presentation measurement or device guarantee.
